purpose: Teach: 鍛冶/臨場/北極/トップニュース/被写体/防い/訃報/何もの

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 伝統工芸の、本気で、絶対、鍛冶、絶対、職人、絶対、当社、絶対、支援しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Support traditional craft blacksmiths with everything we have. I'm serious — this matters. Make it happen.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative cadence. Each phrase lands with weight. No room for negotiation in the tone, but not unkind. The voice of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社CM、本気で、絶対、臨場、絶対、感、絶対、出る撮影、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're moving forward on our commercial shoot with full immersion in the craft. The authenticity is coming through.
lines.style: Steady, measured delivery. Speaking as someone reporting progress on a mission. Slight formality — respectful nod to the directive. Confident but not casual.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 北極、本気で、絶対、観測隊、絶対、当社、絶対、協賛、絶対、検討しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Look into sponsoring the Arctic research expedition. It aligns with who we are. I need options by end of week.
lines.style: Direct, expectant tone. Not a question — a brief from someone who trusts his team to understand the urgency. Purposeful pace, no softening.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の新製品、本気で、絶対、トップニュース、絶対、取り上げていただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. Our new product line actually made top news — we got significant coverage yesterday. It validates our approach.
lines.style: Slightly lifted energy. Reporting a win without overplaying it. The tone of someone bringing good news to someone who doesn't celebrate easily. Genuine but measured.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新CMの、本気for、絶対、被写体、絶対、人選、絶対、慎重にしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: On the new campaign — be careful with casting. Who represents us matters as much as what we're saying.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate. The edge of warning without accusation. Leans on 'careful' — a word that carries weight here. Speaks from experience.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。情報漏洩を、本気で、絶対、防いだ、絶対、当社のシステム、絶対、評価されております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Absolutely. Our security protocols held up under scrutiny — no leaks, no breaches. The systems are being recognized across the industry.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact pride. Speaking of a quiet win. Steady pace, no need for embellishment. The confidence of someone reporting something solid.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業者の、本気で、絶対、訃報、絶対、お得意様、絶対、当社からお伝えしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Our founder's passing — make sure our long-standing clients hear it from us first. Direct, respectful, personal.
lines.style: Solemn, precise. Each word chosen carefully. The tone of someone handling something that demands gravity and care. Quiet but unmistakable in its weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の理念、本気で、絶対、何もの、絶対、にも、絶対、代えがたい、絶対、ものです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our company's foundation — it's irreplaceable. That principle is what everything we do comes back to.
lines.style: Quiet reflection beneath the formality. Speaking with genuine feeling, not performing it. Slower pace on the closing. The weight of sincerity.
